window-1.title: The Deep Sea
window-1.blurb: Wildcard detour — scroll straight down eleven kilometres into the black and watch the light die out as glowing, impossible creatures drift past at their real depths; it's the most patient, eerie, beautiful thing on the web and I guarantee you'll come out the other end wanting to build an anglerfish costume.

window-2.title: Announcing the 2026 LensCulture Art Photography Award Winners
window-2.blurb: A fresh dump of photographers nobody's told you about yet — staged worlds, strange grain, invented selves — basically a scroll designed to give you your next shoot idea before you finish it.

window-3.title: Carrot Shrub (Nonalcoholic)
window-3.blurb: It's a vinegar-bright, sesame-peppery, glowing-orange drink that starts with you pickling your own baby carrots — a side quest in a glass, and the exact shade of orange that photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: Best of 2025: Living Rooms (The Nordroom)
window-4.blurb: A whole year of warm, collected, lamp-lit living rooms in one scroll — the kind where every object clearly has a story, which is exactly how your place already works.

window-5.title: Behind Clay — the hidden room behind the pizza oven
window-5.blurb: There's no sign and no door — you walk straight through a riverside pizzeria, past the wood-fired oven, into a secret 52-seat lounge serving mala pork belly out of a paper bag and foie gras pizza with tamarind, which feels like a place built specifically for you to show up overdressed and make an entire night of it.
